mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate directly lowers discount rates for equity valuation, increasing present value of future cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when UNRATE increases by >0.2pp over three months over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, accelerating corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint strength of HOUST and RSAFS (both above 50th percentile) fails to predict positive 20-day returns in >55% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO below 95.0) during supply chain disruptions reduces manufacturing output and corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when INDPRO is below 95.0 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rapid inflation acceleration (CPIAUCSL rising >0.3 percentage points over three months) triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when CPIAUCSL increases by >0.3pp over three months over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong job growth (PAYEMS exceeding 150,000 monthly additions) consistently supports consumer spending and corporate earnings momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 150,000 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions (GDPC1 annual growth above 2.5%), sustained GDP momentum supports corporate profitability and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when GDPC1 annual growth exceeds 2.5% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in industrial production (INDPRO below 95.0) and housing starts (HOUST below 700.0) signals broad economic slowdown, reducing corporate investment and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint weakness of INDPRO and HOUST (both below thresholds) fails to predict negative 20-day returns in >55% of cases over a 5-year rolling window.
